The skin lacks the distinct, sharp definition of individual barnacles/callosities expected in a high-quality photo. It appears somewhat 'painted' or smudged rather than having discrete biological textures.
The interaction between the whale's body and the water surface is slightly unnatural; the splash/wake is indistinct and blends into the body without clear displacement physics.
